abilities.desc_en: Power Burn 1

abilities.desc_en: Attack Debuff 1

abilities.title_en: Heavy Attacks: Mirage shrugs off Ranged Attacks and Burn Debuffs when speeding up as an F1 car.
abilities.desc_zh: 重击：幻影在作为 F1 赛车加速时不会受到远程攻击和燃烧减益的影响。
abilities.desc_en: Heavy Attacks: Mirage shrugs off Ranged Attacks and Burn Debuffs when speeding up as an F1 car.

abilities.title_zh: 远程攻击：{{var_1}} 破甲穿透
abilities.desc_zh: 远程攻击：{{var_1}} 破甲穿透
abilities.desc_en: Ranged Attacks: {{var_1}} Armor Penetration

abilities.title_en: Passive: Mirage starts the fight in Power Mode, granting +{{var_2}} Power Rate. While in this mode, Mirage activates a Shield when the opponent activates a Special Attack. The shield decreases enemy Critical Damage and Ranged Damage by {{var_3}} until Mirage is knocked down. The shield requires {{var_4}} before it may re-activate.
abilities.desc_zh: 被动：Mirage 在能量模式下开始战斗，获得 +{{var_2}} 能量值。在此模式下，当对手激活特殊技时，幻影会激活护盾。护盾会减少敌人的暴击伤害和远程伤害 {{var_3}}，直到幻影被击倒。该防护罩需要 {{var_4}} 才能重新激活。
abilities.desc_en: Passive: Mirage starts the fight in Power Mode, granting +{{var_2}} Power Rate. While in this mode, Mirage activates a Shield when the opponent activates a Special Attack. The shield decreases enemy Critical Damage and Ranged Damage by {{var_3}} until Mirage is knocked down. The shield requires {{var_4}} before it may re-activate.

abilities.title_en: Mirage has a chance to return to this mode from other modes when struck by enemy attacks.
abilities.desc_zh: 当受到敌人攻击时，幻影有机会从其他模式返回到此模式。
abilities.desc_en: Mirage has a chance to return to this mode from other modes when struck by enemy attacks.

abilities.title_zh: K.E.R.S - 动能恢复系统在激活特殊技时会产生以下增益：
abilities.title_en: K.E.R.S - The Kinetic Energy Recovery System generates the following buffs when activating Special Attacks:
abilities.desc_zh:
特殊 1 - 更快的射弹，持续 {{var_5}} 秒。

特殊 2 - {{var_6}} 秒内不可阻挡的基本近战攻击。

特殊 3 - +{{var_7}} 攻击 {{var_8}} 秒。

每级 +{{var_9}}。

（每次特殊技都会刷新增益效果，本质上是让他在特殊技期间充分利用增益效果，并且只会在特殊技结束后倒计时。）
abilities.desc_en:
K.E.R.S - The Kinetic Energy Recovery System generates the following buffs when activating Special Attacks:
Special 1 - Faster projectiles for {{var_5}}seconds.
Special 2 - Unblockable basic Melee Attacks for {{var_6}}seconds.
Special 3 - +{{var_7}} Attack for {{var_8}}seconds.
+{{var_9}} per level.
(The buffs refresh for each special attack hit, essentially letting him take full advantage of the buffs during the Specials and only counts down after it ends.)

abilities.desc_zh: 快速热身以击倒敌人的大脑车库中的繁荣。
abilities.desc_en: Jump Start - A quick warm-up to knock the boom glitches out the enemy's brain garage.

abilities.desc_zh: Mirage 进入干扰模式，在该模式下远程攻击有 {{var_10}} 机会消耗 {{var_11}} 能量。
abilities.desc_en: Mirage enters Disruption Mode, granting Ranged Attacks a {{var_10}} chance to drain {{var_11}} Power while in the mode.

abilities.desc_zh: 使用技术和技巧的秘密方法有助于保持刚打蜡的光泽。
abilities.desc_en: Sleight of Hand and Fist -  A stealth approach using technology and trickery helps maintain that freshly-waxed shine.

abilities.desc_zh: +{{var_17}}~{{var_18}} 躲避对手攻击时进行下一次攻击。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_17}}~{{var_18}} Attack on the next hit when dodging opponents' attacks.

abilities.desc_zh: +{{var_19}}~{{var_20}} 远程攻击的暴击率。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_19}}~{{var_20}} Critical Rate on ranged attacks.

abilities.desc_zh: {{var_21}}~{{var_22}} 在使用特殊 2 或 3 击球时激活对手能力的可能性较小。
abilities.desc_en: {{var_21}}~{{var_22}} less likely to activate the opponent's abilities when hitting with Special 2 or 3.
+{{var_23}}~{{var_24}} Critical Damage.

abilities.desc_zh: +{{var_25}}~{{var_26}} 屏蔽时伤害扣除。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_25}}~{{var_26}} damage deduction when Shielded.

abilities.desc_zh: 冲击波会从震惊的对手身上消耗更多 {{var_27}}~{{var_28}} 的能量。
abilities.desc_en: Shockwave Drains {{var_27}}~{{var_28}} more Power from Shocked opponents.

abilities.desc_zh: 使用{{var_31}}~{{var_32}} Power开始战斗。仅当团队中的所有机器人都具有此协同羁绊时才适用。
abilities.desc_en: Start the fight with {{var_31}}~{{var_32}} Power. Only applies if all Bots on the team have this Synergy.

abilities.desc_zh: 所有较低级别的队友都会获得+{{var_33}} 功率值。
abilities.desc_en: All lower tier teammates gain +{{var_33}} Power Rate.
